positions.name: PlanningCallSettledItems
positions.frame: What did the group settle as operating facts on the 2026-10-01 planning call, across the archive, the diagnostic and the orchard?
positions.why: Three separate assertions (archive retention, Thistlewick diagnostic sequencing, orchard grafting timing) are each ratified by the expressive 'Agreed on all three.' The ratification performs the settling act across all three items, so one frame spans them. The items are distinct subjects, so the frame reads the set as what was settled, not as one shared topic. The observations mark src-1 to src-3 as plain assertions and src-4 as the performed decision, which the frame holds together without resolving any of the three items.
